source: Proposed by the platform team. Legal and the CPO decide (OPN-07, CR-03).
note: Periods run from the candidate's last activity: the newest of the day we recorded them, their last application, their last stage move, their last evaluation and their last consent. Nothing is erased while a candidate is still in the process.

rules.note: Sourced from a job board or a profile; never applied to us and never gave consent. We hold data they did not hand us, so this is the shortest period.
No period: a candidate still being considered is not erased. Their clock starts on the day they are rejected, hired or withdraw.
Long enough to approach them again for a later opening, and to answer a complaint about how they were treated.
After that the employment file in HR is the record, not this system.
They asked us to stop keeping their data. The record locks the moment it is recorded; the month is only so a request recorded against the wrong person can be lifted.
